{"code":"def transform(g):
 h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
 # locate 8 pattern and its anchor color (nonzero neighboring cell)
 p=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==8]
 if not p:return out
 # anchor is non-8 cell in bounding vicinity, choose 1
 anchors=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==1 and any(abs(r-a)<=2 and abs(c-b)<=2 for a,b in p)]
 if not anchors:return out
 ar,ac=anchors[0]
 # lower 1 component, preferably isolated; use first 1 cell below pattern
 q=[(r,c) for r in range(ar+1,h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==1]
 if not q:return out
 br,bc=q[0]
 # determine scale from contiguous 1 run dimensions at lower object
 sw=1
 while bc+sw<w and g[br][bc+sw]==1: sw+=1
 sh=1
 while br+sh<h and g[br+sh][bc]==1: sh+=1
 # apply offsets of 8 relative anchor, preserving nonzero destination
 for r,c in p:
  dr,dc=r-ar,c-ac
  for i in range(sh):
   for j in range(sw):
    rr=br+dr*sh+i; cc=bc+dc*sw+j
    if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]==0: out[rr][cc]=8
 return out"}
